theme: An open day in St. Pete, with the Croatia trip calling
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is clear until Martin's call tomorrow, so today's shape is yours to set. A few overdue trip bookings and a couple of replies are the only things tugging.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus sailing balance is outstanding
needsAttention.detail: Invoice 2170 from Nautilus shows a $6,475 balance, and Amy followed up that the final course payment is due with the September start now close.

needsAttention.title: Two lodging gaps for Croatia are still open
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 night in Cavtat and the Sept 20-22 St. Pete landing gap are both past their target dates on the Mike + Dan board, and both need to be booked from dry land before you fly out Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Get the Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Eurowings Discover; confirming the allowance on the operating carrier now is far cheaper than sorting it at the counter with two 55L duffels.

needsAttention.title: Martin at Valoris calls at noon tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: Your only fixed thing tomorrow is the Valoris call at 12 on Teams; a few minutes today to frame what you want out of it will pay off.

needsAttention.title: Kerrie's Kuala Lumpur invite needs a yes or no
needsAttention.detail: Kerrie Waring wrote on the 24th asking if you'd come along to the KL event to meet a new corporate audience; speaking slots are filled but she flags it as a good room, and she leaves for Tokyo Sept 26.

flagged.title: Liberty Mutual home renewal notice
flagged.detail: Your home policy renewal notice arrived this morning, worth a look before it auto-renews.

flagged.title: Mike scouted local sailing practice
flagged.detail: Mike forwarded the St. Pete Sailing Center's reply on getting out on the water to practice before the Croatia course.

inbox.noise: The usual LinkedIn and Nexxt job-board alerts, an Enterprise rental agreement, and a sailing-materials shipping notice.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply.

recipe.title: Sautéed zucchini with scallions & fresh mozzarella
recipe.why: High summer means zucchini and basil are at their peak — a quick sauté lets them shine.

tasks.title: Assemble the passport packet for the four girls

acts.line: Nothing on the books this morning, a rare fully open start.
The afternoon stays clear and yours to direct.
Home with the girls in St. Pete for a quiet evening in.
